summary_en: This study tests autologous T cells engineered to express a chimeric antigen receptor, either huMNC2-CAR44 or huMNC2-CAR22, which target a cleaved form of MUC1 (MUC1*) in advanced metastatic breast cancer. The engineered cells are given by infusion, with the dose tested in cohorts of 3 patients, and how often and for how long they are given is not stated. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the registry lists the study as Phase 1, and the brief summary describes it as Phase I/II.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa células T autólogas modificadas para expresar un receptor de antígeno quimérico, huMNC2-CAR44 o huMNC2-CAR22, que actúan contra una forma escindida de MUC1 (MUC1*) en cáncer de mama metastásico avanzado. Las células modificadas se administran por infusión, y la dosis se prueba en grupos de 3 pacientes; la frecuencia y la duración del tratamiento no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el registro clasifica el estudio como Fase 1, y el resumen breve lo describe como Fase I/II.
who_for: Breast cancer confirmed by pathology, with MUC1* membrane expression of at least 30% by immunohistochemistry.
Received standard metastatic systemic therapy; hormone receptor positive patients need at least 3 endocrine therapies and 2 chemotherapy lines.
HER2-positive patients need at least 3 HER2-directed therapies; triple negative patients need at least 2 chemotherapy lines.
Age 18 or older, able to give written informed consent, with Karnofsky performance status of at least 60%.
Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1 on CT or MRI, or bone-only disease measurable by FDG PET.
not_for: Daily corticosteroid use above 15 mg prednisone per day or equivalent.
Major organ dysfunction, such as high creatinine, high bilirubin, high liver enzymes, or reduced lung function.
Significant heart problems, such as NYHA class III or IV heart failure, or ejection fraction below 45%.
Low blood counts: ANC under 1000/mm³, hemoglobin under 9, or platelets under 75,000/mm³.
HIV positive, uncontrolled active infection, untreated brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis, or anticipated survival under 3 months.
